trial_allocation.allocation_rationale: Baseline model — fixed defaults, no HPO needed.

XGBoost has a large, complex search space with many interacting regularization and tree-building parameters. With 10,987 samples, it can support deep trees and needs sufficient trials to converge on the optimal MAE.
LightGBM's leaf-wise growth and numerous hyperparameters (num_leaves, min_data_in_leaf) require extensive exploration. It is highly sensitive to HPO and a top contender for this dataset size.
Sklearn's GradientBoosting has a smaller search space than XGBoost/LightGBM but still needs tuning for learning_rate and max_depth. 15 trials is sufficient to find a strong baseline ensemble.
Random Forest is less sensitive to hyperparameters than boosting models, but tuning max_depth and min_samples_split on 38 features still requires moderate exploration to prevent overfitting.
Extra Trees introduces additional randomness and is generally less sensitive to HPO than Random Forest. 10 trials is enough to explore its key variance-reduction parameters.
Ridge regression only requires tuning the alpha regularization parameter. 5 trials is more than enough to cover the log-scale search space.
Similar to Ridge, Lasso only needs alpha tuning. 5 trials will efficiently find the optimal sparsity-inducing penalty.

checklist.comment: All selected models and the MAE metric are appropriate for a regression task.
A dummy_mean baseline is included to establish a minimum performance threshold.
50 max total trials across 7 HPO-enabled models may be too low for Optuna TPE to adequately explore complex tree-based model spaces.
K-fold cross-validation is well-suited for a dataset of approximately 11,000 samples.
MAE is consistently defined as both the primary and evaluation metric.
Cross-validation and HPO will help mitigate overfitting; dataset size is sufficient for the chosen models.
Training 50 trials on roughly 11k samples and 38 features is computationally lightweight.
Standard HPO and CV methods are selected; assuming random seeds are managed in the execution environment.

non_blocking_risks.message: A maximum of 50 total trials shared among 7 HPO-enabled models limits the search space exploration for Optuna TPE, potentially leading to suboptimal hyperparameter configurations for complex models like XGBoost and LightGBM.
non_blocking_risks.suggested_action: Consider increasing the total trial budget (e.g., to 100-200) or implementing a successive halving strategy to allocate trials more efficiently across models.

future_improvement_suggestions: Consider adding a standard Linear Regression without HPO as an additional interpretable baseline alongside dummy_mean.
Plan for post-hoc interpretability analysis (e.g., SHAP values or feature importance plots) for the winning tree-based model to provide business context.
